title: Israel orders West Bank lockdown after shooting
gist: A short Al-Monitor 'Middle East Minute' podcast blurb: Israel ordered a West Bank lockdown after a shooting, Saudi Arabia reportedly expanding missile capabilities, and the UAE closed beaches after a Gulf oil spill. Little substantive text beyond the headline items.
